test_source: PYAT_CONTROL_ROOM/24_HQD125_DDM_FUNCTIONAL_CONSERVATION_AND_PREV3_ACCEPTANCE_LAW.md §15 (narrow) — reopen only if a required functional responsibility has no lawful current representation, no owner, cannot be transported, cannot be validated/refused, cannot be composed at the required grain, AND cannot be satisfied by lawful same-grain succession or bounded implementation.
criterion_A: Current architecture already has lawful representational homes; remaining work is bounded implementation/authority materialization.
criterion_B: A required F6/F7 relation has no lawful current representation/owner and architecture may need reopening.
criterion_C: A high-consequence current-law fork is genuinely underdetermined and Astra consultation is warranted.

evidence: F6 composition-without-pooling is IMPLEMENTED: SOURCE_INDEXED_MULTI_UNIVERSE yields one fact per universe in a single result and never a merged row.
F6 composition authority is IMPLEMENTED and fail-closed: AUTHORIZED_COMPOSITE requires pooling, nonduplication and estimand_composition role authorities.
F7 has a lawful INGRESS home: M1 is a fail-closed gate that already specifies the exact families, signatures and fingerprints a producer must satisfy.
F8 consumer seam and actor firewall are IMPLEMENTED.
Structural admission already carries time, uncertainty, geography and noncomparability SLOTS.

B.why_not: Criterion B requires that a relation cannot be satisfied by lawful same-grain succession or bounded implementation. Every missing owner fails that test in the AFFIRMATIVE sense: M1 defines the ingress contract, pre553_structural_admission defines the admission shape with time slots, and pre553_empirical_query defines the composition shape. A temporal producer is therefore BOUNDED IMPLEMENTATION inside the present DAG — exactly the remedy HQD-125 §15 names when reopen is not triggered.
B.the_closest_thing_to_B: The typed cross-source RELATION (corroboration/contradiction/complementarity) has no owner and no current representation. But a relation object composed from already-source-indexed facts is again bounded implementation, not a representational impossibility.

C.question: For multi-source comparison, is temporal identity keyed on a point year or on a fieldwork interval?
why_genuinely_underdetermined: No binding law names a time grain.
The historical point-year choice was scoped to a single-family, single-country track and was never established as adequate for nonaligned fieldwork intervals.
The current slots are untyped, so nothing prevents a caller smuggling a midpoint year.
Case C cannot be answered without deciding it.
C.why_not_lane_disposition: Calling the whole lane an Astra matter would be calling Astra merely because work remains. The ontology is overwhelmingly determinate, and the fork blocks ONE case (C), not F7 as a whole.
C.what_Astra_would_be_asked: Whether cross-family temporal comparison keys on fieldwork interval or point year, and what typed noncomparability follows when intervals do not overlap.
does_not_block: case A same-survey F7 (point-year is conservative and adequate there)
case B, D's F7 half, E, F's per-track halves, G's F6 half

conclusion.primary: A — lawful homes exist; the remaining work is bounded implementation and authority materialization.
conclusion.with_one_named_fork: C — exactly one high-consequence fork (time grain for cross-family comparison) is genuinely underdetermined and is referred out rather than decided here.
conclusion.not: B — architecture reopen is NOT triggered. No required relation is unrepresentable in the present DAG.

explicitly_not_done: Did not decide the time-grain fork.
Did not adopt any Field Forge vocabulary as current ontology.
Did not inherit linear interpolation, anchor_copy, scalar pressure coefficients, or historical stage topology.
Did not create a temporal producer, relation object or world container — this lane is documentary.
Did not close F6 or F7, and did not claim R9 progress.
Did not perform any production mutation, survey access, or actor/person implementation.
